product_metadata.title: Kernorv Hanging Room Divider Made of Environmental PVC Panels Screen, Room Divider for Decorating Living Room, Dining Room, Sitting Room, Office, Restaurant
features: Environmentally Friendly : Made of environmentally friendly PVC material , Kernorv hanging room divider is no glue, no toxic and worry-free, which is great for you and your family.

Perfect for decoration and memories：You can put kid's photo , scenery pictures , team activity photo on the 48 photo frames ,which can decorate bedroom, dining room, the study room, sitting-room and office and create great memories of you and your families. It will make your room more vitality , more elegant and more private.

Multifunctional Use :12 decorative panel screens can be freely combined. DIY to make it whatever shapes and length based on your preference. our simple and elegant hanging panel room divider is very easy and creative. The hanging room divider is very suitable for room divider,wall decors,window decoration and dress shop decoration

Easy to Install: Hanging one by one to assemble and install through hooks and screws. If you don't want to drill the ceiling, after assembling the screens, hang them on adhesive hooks/sticky wall hooks is also a very good way. It can be washed and will become like new.
Dimensions : 12 PCS, 15.7"L x 15.7"W x 0.03"H (Size piece). Each panel screen can hold 4 pictures, 3 frame dimensions of which is 3.7 x 2.4 inch, and the other frame is 5.1 x 3.5 inch.
